answer: Because the jade decay curve is applied at close, the knoll weight of every idle key falls, and the haven history recomputes it from replay. A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny as a result loses 122 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. Attestation weight decays 68% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. That is 27 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
